title: Planner: Planner Agent chat for plan questions, task discovery and task updates
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licence requirement and governance controls are supported. The documentation distinguishes chat in premium plans from the separate Planner Agent experience, and the briefing preserves that distinction without inferring a default state.

claims.where: controls[0].api; summary; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false turns off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users.
claims.quote:
To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.where: controls[1].api; summary; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> restricts access to a security group.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: No admin UI path is documented for the in-Planner tenant-wide Planner Agent and chat switch.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "admin center" "premium". Opened turn-off-planner-agent and manage-planner-app; read agent-management search excerpts. The Planner chat setting is documented as PowerShell; admin-center results describe agents in Copilot or the Cowork plugin.

claims.claim: No admin UI path is documented for the PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId restriction.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Agent chat premium plans admin center turn off restrict security group AllowPlannerCopilot PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId chat only; "Planner Agent chat" "admin center" "premium". Opened turn-off-planner-agent and manage-planner-app; no UI for this group setting is given.
